# A customer whose `guid:` is a number with a decimal point, unquoted.
#
# The format reads it as a number with a fractional part and keeps the
# characters it was written with, so the guid check reads the text `1.5`,
# which is no guid.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the block, quoting
# `1.5`.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_guid_that_is_not_text_is_refused.py.
customer "C-DECIMAL"
	name: "Guid Written As A Decimal"
	currency: CAD
	guid: 1.5
